title: [Master]-]Withholding Tax Entries are not generated at payment because the Withholding Tax. Prod. Posting Group field gets not transferred to the payment line
summary: The Withholding Tax Prod. Posting Group field is now carried over to the payment line, so Withholding Tax Entries are created again when the payment is posted.
key_points: The Withholding Tax Prod. Posting Group field was not transferred to payment lines
Because of this, no Withholding Tax Entries were generated at payment
New logic in codeunit Withholding Tax Jnl Subscriber transfers the field
A test was added to ERM Withholding Tax Tests II
